summary: Tested Mews-parity AI features (Batch 1): Smart Tips, Duplicate Guest Auto-Merge, BI AI Summary. Backend: 16/16 tests passed. Frontend: Smart Tips and Duplicate Merge UI verified working. BI Summary navigation issue - could not reach Market Robot Performance tab but API verified working via curl.

integration_issues.issue: Could not navigate to Market Robot → Performance tab where BiAiSummaryCard is rendered. The Revenue & Rates hub doesn't show Market Robot as a searchable item. Navigation path unclear.

action_items: Verify navigation path to Market Robot Performance tab - BiAiSummaryCard may not be accessible from current UI navigation
Consider adding Market Robot to Revenue & Rates hub search or sidebar

success_rate.frontend: 66% (2/3 features verified - Smart Tips, Duplicate Merge working; BI Summary navigation issue)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 Mews-parity backend APIs working: POST /api/mews-ai/smart-tips, GET /api/mews-ai/duplicate-guests, POST /api/mews-ai/merge-guests, POST /api/mews-ai/bi-summary. Frontend Smart Tips card works in Guest Profiles panel (click guest → see AI Smart Tips card → click Öneri Üret). Duplicate Merge dialog works (Guest Profiles → Duplicate Merge button → dialog shows clusters). BI Summary card is in PerformanceReport.js which is rendered inside MarketRobot.js - navigation to this component was not successful via UI.

backend_1_smart_tips.details: POST /api/mews-ai/smart-tips returns tips array with icon/title/action, model=gpt-4o-mini, generated_at timestamp. Tested with VIP profile (5 tips), minimal profile (fallback), missing profile (400), nonexistent guest_id (404), unauthorized (401)

backend_2_duplicate_guests.details: GET /api/mews-ai/duplicate-guests returns total_guests_scanned, clusters_found, clusters array. Each cluster has cluster_id, reason (e.g. 'AYNI TELEFON'), size>=2, guests array

backend_3_merge_guests.details: POST /api/mews-ai/merge-guests with primary_id and duplicate_ids merges profiles. Returns ok=true, removed_dupes count, moved_bookings count. Tested validation (missing params, primary in duplicates, nonexistent primary)

backend_4_bi_summary.details: POST /api/mews-ai/bi-summary returns summary_md with Turkish text, emoji bullets, 'ÖNCELİK BU HAFTA' action line. Snapshot includes property stats. Model=gpt-4o-mini

frontend_5_smart_tips_card.details: Guest Profiles → click guest → AI Smart Tips card visible → click 'Öneri Üret' → tips list appears with 5 tips (Hoşgeldin Notu, Hediyelik İkram, Kahve Servisi, Gece İkramı, Özel İletişim)

frontend_6_duplicate_merge_dialog.details: Guest Profiles → Duplicate Merge button → dialog opens → shows '51 misafir tarandı, 7 potansiyel duplicate grup' → clusters with 'AYNI TELEFON' reason → Birleştir buttons

frontend_7_bi_ai_summary_card.details: Could not navigate to Market Robot Performance tab. BiAiSummaryCard is rendered in PerformanceReport.js inside MarketRobot.js. Backend API verified working via curl.
